text:
ana: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — we need owners, Jira tickets, and handoffs for the cache-eviction incidents. Short version: recurring KV cache thrash during traffic spikes; partial mitigation applied but we need definite owners and verification steps.

matt: +1. Can we list concrete action items with owners and due dates? I'll own the short-term rollout.

sophie: RACI suggestion: R=Raj, A=Ana, C=Eng-SRE, I=Product. Add Support for evals.

raj: fine with R. I'll open the primary investigation ticket and scope the logs.

jira-bot: Created RW-3721: "Investigate root cause of KV cache thrash" assigned to raj, due 2026-04-05. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3721

ana: (typo correction) ana: Updated plan below — please confirm owners and ACs: 
1) Short-term: tweak eviction threshold + add targeted alerting (owner: matt, ticket RW-3722, due 2026-03-30).
2) Mid-term: per-tenant KV quota and deterministic eviction policy (owner: raj, ticket RW-3723, due 2026-04-12).
3) Long-term: evaluate caching algorithm + perf regression tests in Redwood Optimize (owner: sophie, ticket RW-3724, due 2026-05-01).

matt: ACK. RW-3722 I'll canary tonight and then roll. Plan to ping @oncall-bot for smoke.

matt: canary command I'm using:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/cache-workers --image=redwood/cache:staging-canary
```

oncall-bot: scheduled canary deploy at 2026-03-24T02:00:00Z.

kim: I'll take the dashboards/alert thresholds handoff from eng-sre. Owner: kim, ticket RW-3725, due 2026-03-31.

sophie: I'll add the eval prompt sets and regression checks to the Optimize pipeline; will pair with DataOps.

ana: (again, ana) Please include acceptance criteria in each Jira ticket. Example ACs: 1) eviction spikes <= 2/min at 2x baseline traffic, 2) p95 latency change < 5%, 3) no increase in error rate.

raj: adding ACs to RW-3721 and linking playbooks.

matt: one more callout — pattern: spikes align with nightly batch job at ~01:30 UTC. Product should evaluate batching. Can someone loop in the product PM (@anna-p)?

ana: I'll create a cross-team ticket RW-3726 for batch-scheduling review and assign to Product PM, due 2026-04-06.

sophie: tiny request — add a recurring quarterly review on the postmortem board to catch these patterns. Also tag incidents with "recurring-incidents".

ana: will set up the board label and monthly metrics export to shared drive.

matt: timeline looks good. I'll post canary results in this thread and update RW-3722 when done.

jira-bot: RW-3722 updated: status In Progress — comment: canary scheduled. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3722

raj: pairing session with matt tomorrow 09:00 PST to review eviction logs and KV hit-rate graphs.

ana: RACI doc updated in the repo: R=Raj, A=Ana, C=Eng-SRE (matt, kim), I=Product (TBD), Support=Sophie (evals). I'll attach the RACI link to each Jira ticket.

matt: :thumbsup:

kim: I'll take the dashboard handoff; ping me for queries or sample queries/metrics export.

ana: Closing the loop for now — we'll reconvene here after canary and once tickets have ACs. Thanks everyone, great execution.
